﻿﻿This mod adds 60+ beautiful indoor items for you to decorate,
house and nurture your lovely forest friends and critters!

Made to match the original: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16874]Fairy Garden Furniture[/url] for Outdoors!

This is all new furniture using Content Patcher!
You can find the furniture either using something like CJB Item Spawner
OR you can purchase the brand new Fairy Garden Furniture Catalogue from Robin's Shop!

As always, check your config for [b]recolor options.[/b]
Toned down recolor made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url]﻿, Bog recolor by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/about-me?gameId=1303]BogWyytch[/url]﻿
Huge special thanks to Yri who allowed me to use her foliage!
